notes: Photo-reading on a self-hosted vision endpoint no longer poisons its own queue. The old path held one HTTP connection open across the cold start, so every client-side deadline abandoned a job that RunPod had already queued and would still run: one photo that waited out six attempts left ten dead reads stacked ahead of the live one, and the endpoint could never catch up. Reads now submit a single job and poll it, so a slow first boot costs nothing — the job keeps its place however long the model takes, and the wait can run to 15 minutes. A gateway that hangs up with no HTTP status now trips the same three-strikes stop as a repeated error instead of being retried until the budget dies, dropped connections get their own time allowance rather than eating the cold-start extension, and Settings has a Purge queued jobs button for backlogs left by earlier versions.
